column2:
cabbage(n.)高麗菜、甘藍菜
(無詞性變化)
Chinese cabbage 大白菜
cabbage soup 高麗菜湯
My mom bought a big cabbage at the market.
(我媽媽在市場買了一顆大高麗菜。)
Cabbage is cheap and healthy.
(高麗菜便宜又健康。)

café(n.)咖啡館、小餐館
cafe(n.)咖啡館(同 café)
internet café 網咖
a small café 一間小咖啡館
Let's meet at the café near the station.
(我們在車站附近的咖啡館碰面吧。)
She often studies in a quiet café.
(她常在一間安靜的咖啡館讀書。)

cage(n./v.)籠子、把⋯關進籠子
caged(adj.)關在籠中的
bird cage 鳥籠
in a cage 在籠子裡
The bird is singing in its cage.
(那隻鳥在籠子裡唱歌。)
The lion was caged at the zoo.
(那隻獅子被關在動物園的籠子裡。)

calendar(n.)日曆、行事曆
(無詞性變化)
lunar calendar 農曆
mark the calendar 在日曆上做記號
I marked her birthday on my calendar.
(我在日曆上標記了她的生日。)
Chinese New Year follows the lunar calendar.
(農曆新年是依照農曆來定的。)

calm(v./adj./n.)使平靜、冷靜的、平靜
calmly(adv.)冷靜地
calmness(n.)平靜、鎮定
calm down 冷靜下來
stay calm 保持冷靜
Please calm down and tell me what happened.
(請冷靜下來，告訴我發生了什麼事。)
The sea is calm this morning.
(今天早上海面很平靜。)

camel(n.)駱駝
(無詞性變化)
ride a camel 騎駱駝
camel hump 駝峰
Camels can live in the desert for days without water.
(駱駝可以在沙漠中好幾天不喝水。)
We rode a camel in Egypt.
(我們在埃及騎了駱駝。)

cancel(v.)取消
cancellation(n.)取消
cancel a meeting 取消會議
cancel an order 取消訂單
The game was canceled because of the rain.
(比賽因為下雨被取消了。)
I had to cancel my trip to Japan.
(我不得不取消去日本的旅行。)

cancer(n.)癌症
(無詞性變化)
lung cancer 肺癌
cancer patient 癌症病患
Smoking can cause lung cancer.
(抽菸可能導致肺癌。)
My uncle beat cancer two years ago.
(我舅舅兩年前戰勝了癌症。)

candle(n.)蠟燭
candlelight(n.)燭光
light a candle 點蠟燭
blow out the candles 吹熄蠟燭
She blew out the candles on her birthday cake.
(她吹熄了生日蛋糕上的蠟燭。)
We lit a candle when the power went out.
(停電時我們點了一根蠟燭。)

capital(n./adj.)首都、資本、大寫字母、主要的
capitalism(n.)資本主義
capital city 首都
capital letter 大寫字母
Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
(東京是日本的首都。)
Start each sentence with a capital letter.
(每個句子的開頭要用大寫字母。)

cartoon(n./v.)卡通、漫畫、畫漫畫
cartoonist(n.)漫畫家
cartoon character 卡通人物
watch cartoons 看卡通
Kids love to watch cartoons on Saturday morning.
(孩子們喜歡在星期六早上看卡通。)
Mickey Mouse is a famous cartoon character.
(米老鼠是一個有名的卡通人物。)

cash(n./v.)現金、兌現
cashier(n.)收銀員
pay in cash 用現金付款
cash a check 兌現支票
Can I pay in cash?
(我可以付現金嗎？)
I don't have any cash with me.
(我身上沒有帶任何現金。)

castle(n.)城堡
(無詞性變化)
sand castle 沙堡
old castle 古堡
The children built a sand castle on the beach.
(孩子們在海灘上蓋了一座沙堡。)
The king lived in a huge castle.
(國王住在一座巨大的城堡裡。)

cause(n./v.)原因、起因、導致
(無詞性變化)
cause and effect 因果
cause trouble 惹麻煩
The heavy rain caused a flood.
(大雨造成了水災。)
What was the cause of the fire?
(火災的原因是什麼？)

ceiling(n.)天花板
(無詞性變化)
high ceiling 挑高的天花板
ceiling fan 吊扇
There is a spider on the ceiling.
(天花板上有一隻蜘蛛。)
The room has a ceiling fan.
(這個房間有一台吊扇。)

cell(n.)細胞、牢房、小隔間
cellular(adj.)細胞的、行動電話的
cell phone 手機
blood cell 血球
Our bodies are made of millions of cells.
(我們的身體是由數百萬個細胞組成的。)
Please turn off your cell phone in class.
(上課時請把手機關機。)

centimeter(n.)公分
(無詞性變化)
ten centimeters long 十公分長
square centimeter 平方公分
This ruler is thirty centimeters long.
(這把尺有三十公分長。)
She grew five centimeters this year.
(她今年長高了五公分。)

central(adj.)中央的、主要的
center(n.)中心
central heating 中央暖氣
central idea 主旨
Our school is in central Taipei.
(我們學校在臺北市中心。)
What is the central idea of this story?
(這個故事的主旨是什麼？)

century(n.)世紀、一百年
(無詞性變化)
the 21st century 二十一世紀
for centuries 好幾個世紀以來
We live in the twenty-first century.
(我們生活在二十一世紀。)
This temple is over three centuries old.
(這座廟已有三百多年的歷史。)

cereal(n.)穀類、麥片
(無詞性變化)
breakfast cereal 早餐麥片
a bowl of cereal 一碗麥片
I eat a bowl of cereal with milk every morning.
(我每天早上吃一碗加牛奶的麥片。)
Rice and wheat are common cereals.
(稻米和小麥是常見的穀物。)

chain(n./v.)鏈條、連鎖店、用鏈子拴住
(無詞性變化)
chain store 連鎖店
food chain 食物鏈
He chained his bike to the tree.
(他用鏈條把腳踏車鎖在樹上。)
There are many chain stores in this city.
(這個城市有很多連鎖店。)

chalk(n./v.)粉筆、用粉筆寫
(無詞性變化)
a piece of chalk 一支粉筆
colored chalk 彩色粉筆
The teacher wrote the answer in chalk.
(老師用粉筆寫下答案。)
Can you give me a piece of chalk?
(你能給我一支粉筆嗎？)

challenge(n./v.)挑戰、向⋯挑戰
challenging(adj.)有挑戰性的
face a challenge 面對挑戰
meet a challenge 迎接挑戰
Learning English is a big challenge for him.
(學英文對他來說是很大的挑戰。)
She challenged me to a game of chess.
(她向我挑戰下一盤西洋棋。)

channel(n./v.)頻道、海峽、管道、引導
(無詞性變化)
TV channel 電視頻道
change the channel 轉台
What channel is the game on?
(比賽在哪一台播？)
Please don't change the channel.
(請不要轉台。)

chapter(n.)(書的)章、回
(無詞性變化)
the first chapter 第一章
a new chapter 新的篇章
Please read Chapter 3 before the next class.
(下次上課前請讀完第三章。)
Going to college is a new chapter in her life.
(上大學是她人生的新篇章。)

character(n.)性格、角色、文字
characteristic(n./adj.)特徵、特有的
main character 主角
Chinese character 中文字
The main character of the movie is a little girl.
(這部電影的主角是一個小女孩。)
He has a strong character.
(他個性很堅強。)

charge(n./v.)收費、費用、充電、控告、負責
charger(n.)充電器
in charge of 負責⋯
free of charge 免費
I need to charge my phone.
(我需要幫手機充電。)
Mr. Lin is in charge of the school library.
(林老師負責學校圖書館。)

chart(n.)圖表
(無詞性變化)
pie chart 圓餅圖
top the charts 登上排行榜冠軍
The chart shows our sales this year.
(這張圖表顯示我們今年的銷售量。)
Her new song topped the charts.
(她的新歌登上排行榜冠軍。)

chase(n./v.)追逐、追趕
(無詞性變化)
chase after 追趕
chase a dream 追夢
The dog is chasing a cat.
(狗正在追一隻貓。)
Never stop chasing your dreams.
(永遠不要停止追逐你的夢想。)

cheat(v./n.)作弊、欺騙、騙子
cheater(n.)作弊者、騙子
cheat on a test 考試作弊
cheat someone out of 騙走某人的⋯
It is wrong to cheat on a test.
(考試作弊是不對的。)
The man cheated her out of her money.
(那個男人騙走了她的錢。)

cheer(v./n.)歡呼、喝采、使振奮
cheerful(adj.)開心的、令人愉快的
cheer up 振作起來
cheer for 為⋯加油
Cheer up! Things will get better.
(振作起來！事情會好轉的。)
We cheered for our team.
(我們為我們的隊伍加油。)

chemical(adj./n.)化學的、化學物質
chemistry(n.)化學
chemist(n.)化學家
chemical change 化學變化
toxic chemicals 有毒化學物質
Some chemicals are dangerous to touch.
(有些化學物質碰觸是危險的。)
Burning paper is a chemical change.
(燒紙是一種化學變化。)

chess(n.)西洋棋
(無詞性變化)
play chess 下西洋棋
chess player 棋手
My grandfather taught me how to play chess.
(我爺爺教我怎麼下西洋棋。)
He is a good chess player.
(他是個很厲害的西洋棋手。)

chief(adj./n.)主要的、首領、主管
chiefly(adv.)主要地
chief reason 主要原因
police chief 警察局長
Money is the chief reason for his choice.
(錢是他做這個選擇的主要原因。)
The chief of the village is very kind.
(這個村子的村長非常和善。)

childhood(n.)童年
child(n.)小孩
childhood memory 童年回憶
happy childhood 快樂的童年
I had a happy childhood in the countryside.
(我在鄉下度過了快樂的童年。)
This song brings back my childhood memories.
(這首歌喚起了我的童年回憶。)

childish(adj.)幼稚的、孩子氣的
child(n.)小孩
childlike(adj.)天真的
childish behavior 幼稚的行為
Don't be childish. 別那麼幼稚。
Stop being so childish!
(別再那麼幼稚了！)
His childish behavior made his mom angry.
(他幼稚的行為讓他媽媽很生氣。)

china(n.)瓷器
(無詞性變化)
fine china 精緻瓷器
china cup 瓷杯
Be careful with that china cup.
(小心那個瓷杯。)
My grandma keeps her best china in the cabinet.
(我奶奶把她最好的瓷器放在櫃子裡。)

chopstick(n.)筷子(單支)、chopsticks(n.)筷子(一雙)
(無詞性變化)
a pair of chopsticks 一雙筷子
use chopsticks 用筷子
Can you eat noodles with chopsticks?
(你會用筷子吃麵嗎？)
I need a new pair of chopsticks.
(我需要一雙新筷子。)

claim(n./v.)聲稱、要求、認領、主張
(無詞性變化)
claim to be 聲稱是
baggage claim 行李提領處
He claims to be a famous singer.
(他聲稱自己是有名的歌手。)
Let's pick up our bags at baggage claim.
(我們去行李提領處拿行李吧。)

clap(v./n.)拍手、鼓掌
(無詞性變化)
clap your hands 拍手
a clap of thunder 一聲雷響
Everyone clapped after her speech.
(她演講完大家都鼓掌了。)
Clap your hands to the music.
(跟著音樂拍手。)

classic(adj./n.)經典的、典型的、經典作品
classical(adj.)古典的
classic movie 經典電影
a classic example 典型的例子
This is a classic movie from the 1950s.
(這是一部 1950 年代的經典電影。)
Romeo and Juliet is a classic.
(《羅密歐與茱麗葉》是一部經典作品。)

classical(adj.)古典的
classic(adj./n.)經典的、經典作品
classical music 古典音樂
classical Chinese 文言文
She listens to classical music when she studies.
(她讀書時聽古典音樂。)
We are learning classical Chinese this semester.
(我們這學期在學文言文。)

classmate(n.)同學
(無詞性變化)
old classmate 老同學
new classmate 新同學
She is my classmate.
(她是我的同學。)
I met an old classmate at the mall.
(我在購物中心遇到一位老同學。)

clever(adj.)聰明的、靈巧的
cleverly(adv.)聰明地、巧妙地
cleverness(n.)聰明
clever idea 好點子
clever with one's hands 手巧
That's a clever idea!
(那是個好點子！)
The clever boy solved the puzzle quickly.
(那個聰明的男孩很快就解開了謎題。)

click(v./n.)點擊、發出喀嚓聲、喀嚓聲
(無詞性變化)
click on 點擊⋯
double-click 點兩下
Click on the link to see more.
(點擊連結看更多內容。)
I heard a click at the door.
(我聽到門口傳來喀嚓一聲。)

climate(n.)氣候
(無詞性變化)
climate change 氣候變遷
warm climate 溫暖的氣候
Taiwan has a warm climate.
(臺灣氣候溫暖。)
Climate change is a big problem today.
(氣候變遷是當今一大問題。)

cloth(n.)布、布料、抹布
clothes(n.)衣服
clothing(n.)衣物、服裝
a piece of cloth 一塊布
cotton cloth 棉布
She wiped the table with a wet cloth.
(她用濕抹布擦桌子。)
This bag is made of cotton cloth.
(這個袋子是用棉布做的。)

clothing(n.)衣物、服裝(總稱)
cloth(n.)布、布料
clothes(n.)衣服
warm clothing 保暖衣物
clothing store 服飾店
Bring warm clothing for the mountain trip.
(這趟登山行程要帶保暖衣物。)
She works at a clothing store.
(她在一家服飾店工作。)

cloudy(adj.)多雲的、陰天的
cloud(n.)雲
cloudy day 陰天
cloudy sky 多雲的天空
It is cloudy today, but it won't rain.
(今天是陰天，但不會下雨。)
I like to read on cloudy days.
(我喜歡在陰天看書。)

coal(n.)煤、煤炭
(無詞性變化)
coal mine 煤礦
burn coal 燒煤
Burning coal makes the air dirty.
(燒煤會讓空氣變髒。)
His grandfather worked in a coal mine.
(他的祖父曾在煤礦工作。)

coast(n.)海岸、海濱
coastal(adj.)沿海的
east coast 東海岸
along the coast 沿著海岸
We drove along the east coast of Taiwan.
(我們沿著臺灣東海岸開車。)
They live in a small town on the coast.
(他們住在海邊的一個小鎮。)

cockroach(n.)蟑螂
roach(n.)蟑螂(口語)
kill a cockroach 打死蟑螂
flying cockroach 會飛的蟑螂
I saw a cockroach in the kitchen.
(我在廚房看到一隻蟑螂。)
She screamed when the cockroach flew.
(蟑螂飛起來時她尖叫了。)

cocoa(n.)可可粉、熱可可
(無詞性變化)
hot cocoa 熱可可
cocoa beans 可可豆
A cup of hot cocoa is nice on a cold day.
(冷天喝一杯熱可可很舒服。)
Chocolate is made from cocoa beans.
(巧克力是用可可豆做的。)

coin(n./v.)硬幣、創造(新詞)
(無詞性變化)
toss a coin 擲硬幣
coin a word 創造新詞
Let's toss a coin to decide.
(我們擲硬幣決定吧。)
I put a ten-dollar coin into the machine.
(我把一枚十元硬幣投進機器。)

cola(n.)可樂
Coke(n.)可口可樂(商標名)
a can of cola 一罐可樂
diet cola 健怡可樂
Too much cola is bad for your teeth.
(喝太多可樂對牙齒不好。)
I'd like a burger and a Coke, please.
(我要一個漢堡和一杯可樂，謝謝。)

college(n.)大學、學院
(無詞性變化)
go to college 上大學
college student 大學生
My brother is going to college next year.
(我哥哥明年要上大學。)
She is a college student in Tainan.
(她是臺南的大學生。)

comb(n./v.)梳子、梳(頭髮)
(無詞性變化)
comb one's hair 梳頭髮
fine-tooth comb 細齒梳
Comb your hair before you go out.
(出門前梳一下頭髮。)
I can't find my comb.
(我找不到我的梳子。)

combine(v.)結合、混合
combination(n.)結合、組合
combine A with B 把 A 和 B 結合
combined effort 共同努力
Combine the flour with the eggs.
(把麵粉和蛋混合在一起。)
She combines work with fun.
(她把工作和娛樂結合在一起。)

comic(adj./n.)滑稽的、喜劇演員、comics(n.)漫畫
comical(adj.)滑稽可笑的
comic book 漫畫書
read comics 看漫畫
My little brother loves reading comics.
(我弟弟很愛看漫畫。)
He bought a new comic book yesterday.
(他昨天買了一本新漫畫書。)

command(n./v.)命令、指揮、掌握
commander(n.)指揮官
give a command 下命令
command of English 英語能力
The dog obeys every command.
(那隻狗會服從每個指令。)
She has a good command of English.
(她英語能力很好。)

commercial(adj./n.)商業的、廣告
commerce(n.)商業
TV commercial 電視廣告
commercial area 商業區
I don't like long TV commercials.
(我不喜歡很長的電視廣告。)
This is a busy commercial area.
(這是個熱鬧的商業區。)

company(n.)公司、陪伴、同伴
companion(n.)同伴
keep someone company 陪伴某人
work for a company 在公司工作
My father works for a computer company.
(我爸爸在一家電腦公司上班。)
I'll keep you company tonight.
(今晚我會陪你。)

compare(v.)比較、比作
comparison(n.)比較
compare A with B 把 A 和 B 比較
compare A to B 把 A 比作 B
Don't compare yourself with others.
(不要拿自己和別人比較。)
Life is often compared to a journey.
(人生常被比作一段旅程。)

complete(adj./v.)完整的、完成
completely(adv.)完全地
completion(n.)完成
complete a task 完成任務
a complete set 一整套
Please complete the form.
(請填完這張表格。)
I completely forgot about the meeting.
(我完全忘了那場會議。)

complex(adj./n.)複雜的、綜合大樓
complexity(n.)複雜性
complex problem 複雜的問題
sports complex 綜合運動中心
This math problem is too complex for me.
(這道數學題對我來說太複雜了。)
There is a new sports complex near my home.
(我家附近有一座新的綜合運動中心。)

concern(n./v.)關心、擔心、與⋯有關
concerned(adj.)擔心的、有關的
be concerned about 擔心⋯
as far as I'm concerned 就我而言
My parents are concerned about my health.
(我父母很擔心我的健康。)
Thank you for your concern.
(謝謝你的關心。)

conclude(v.)下結論、結束
conclusion(n.)結論
conclude that 推斷出⋯
in conclusion 總而言之
The police concluded that it was an accident.
(警方斷定那是一場意外。)
The meeting concluded at five.
(會議在五點結束。)

condition(n./v.)情況、狀態、條件
conditional(adj.)有條件的
in good condition 狀況良好
on one condition 在一個條件下
My old bike is still in good condition.
(我的舊腳踏車狀況還很好。)
You can go, on one condition.
(你可以去，但有一個條件。)

confident(adj.)有信心的、自信的
confidence(n.)信心、自信
confidently(adv.)有信心地
be confident of 對⋯有信心
feel confident 覺得有信心
I am confident that we will win.
